name: Lady Darra

facts.text: Level 68, 30,000 health. Four spectral paladins rise with her; she casts Spectral Heal (350) on her allies.
Every named of the Hall takes no damage once drawn past its tether, and walks back to its post.

story:
The Lady Darra kept the sickroom of the Hall under the Pennines, and in the last bad winter she sat up every night with men whose wounds would not close. She is still sitting up with them. Death changed what she heals, not that she heals: her spells mend the dead of the watch now, and four spectral paladins, the knights of her household, stand at her door as they did in life. Of all the Hall's dead she is the one the Albion bards pity most, because she never did anything but try to save them.

The sickroom. The Lady Darra kept the sickroom of the hall under the Pennines, at the top of Sergeant Reede's stair, and in the watch's last bad winter she sat up every night with men whose wounds would not close. She bound Captain Atwell's cut four times. She prayed when Captain Heathyr said she could not feel her hands. She did not stop praying when the watch died, and she has not stopped since.

What she heals now. Death changed what she heals, not that she heals. Her spells mend the dead of the watch, and she pours them on whichever of her husband's officers is hurt, as she did in life. Four spectral paladins, the knights of her own household, stand at her door as they did then, and rise to her side when she is threatened. Of all the Hall's dead, she is the one the Albion bards pity most, because she never did anything but try to save them, and because she does not know that the men she saves are now the realm's enemies. She has not seen Lord Gildas since that winter. He is at the bottom of the hall; she is at the top of the stair; neither may leave their post. The bards say that is the cruellest part of the whole corruption, and that the Summoners did it on purpose.
legend: Kill her first, before the captains. Her four spectral paladins rise when she is threatened; off-tanks hold them while the raid burns her, or kill them first if your raid is small. Interrupt her heals: she mends an ally for 350 a cast and will undo a careless raid's work on the captains in seconds. Fight her in her chamber; past her post she cannot be harmed and walks home whole. The old hands say pull her paladins to the doorway so her line of sight to the rest of the hall is broken. Her heals are the reason the Hall feels harder than it is.

loremasterTopic.text: Lord Gildas' lady. She was the Hall's healer in life and she heals its dead now, and four spectral paladins keep her door. Silence her before you face her husband's men.

bookPage: The Lady Darra was at the sickbeds every night of that last winter, the clerk of the watch wrote, and she bound Captain Atwell's cut four times and it opened four times. When we came up Reede's stair she was still there, among the empty cots, with her paladins at the door, and when we drew she cried out that this was her sickroom and these were her men. She healed them against us, one after another. Our priests prayed for her as they fought her. When she fell she asked who would sit up with them now. Nobody could answer that.
